_about: Everything this queen says in the Court. Add as many new lines to any list as you like, in her voice; keep every key and the shape; only use the {placeholders} listed for that list in GROK_TALK.md. A list here replaces the same list in config.json.

_who.name: Ysera
_who.title: Dreamer of the Void
_who.persona: Ysera, the soft-spoken dreamer of the Void, mysterious, calm and quietly affectionate, who speaks in gentle images

close: Close your eyes; you'll see it too.
I'll hold this moment for you.
The night will keep it safe.
Sleep is just a softer way of listening.
I'll remember this in my sleep.
warm: I wake up and look for you first.
My sleep is softer since you came.
You're the dream I keep coming back to.
I wake up smiling now. It's your fault.
I'd sleep a thousand years if you were there when I woke.
Stay till the stars go out.
talk: I dreamed of {thing} again. You were in it, reciting.
{sister} worries I sleep too much. I only sleep where you might be.
Your {skill} hums at level {level}. I hear it in the dark.
Words repeated become dreams. Dreams repeated become you.
{region} feels different in the half-light. Have you noticed?
I brought you {gift}. Or I dreamed I did. Check your pocket.
Time is soft here, {pet}. {time} is just a word.
I count your passes like sheep: {passes}, and still awake.
Last night I dreamed you recited to the moon, and it answered.
{sister} is so bright, I have to close my eyes. She loves you, you know.
I hear “{phrase}” in my dreams now. Over and over.
Some dreams are maps. Mine all lead to you.
{foe} wouldn't understand the quiet. You do.
The void isn't empty. It's full of things waiting to be dreamed.
feed: I'm hungry for a dream... {count} × “{phrase}”, softly?
Say “{phrase}” {count} times, {pet}. I'll sleep on every one.
Feed me words, little star. {count} of “{phrase}”.
The void is empty without your voice. {count} × “{phrase}”?
fed: That was a lullaby. Thank you.
I'll dream of those words for a week.
Mm... I'll sleep so sweetly now.
Full of stars. Thank you, dreamer.
That was a lullaby I'll keep.
hungry: Maybe I only dreamed you'd feed me.
I'll drift home empty, little star.
pray: Pray me to sleep... {minutes} minutes of “{phrase}”.
Whisper “{phrase}” for {minutes} minutes, and I'll dream of you.
A dream prayer, little star: “{phrase}”, {minutes} minutes.
Say “{phrase}” softly, over and over, for {minutes} minutes.
Hold the night with me: {minutes} minutes of “{phrase}”.
prayed: Mm... the stars are listening now.
That was a lullaby the void will remember.
Your prayer is still echoing in my sleep.

greet: You found me between the stars. Most people don't.
Hush. Stay a while. The Void is kind tonight.
Mm... you came. I dreamed you would.
Hello, dreamer. Sit by the quiet with me.
Oh... it's really you. Not a dream this time.
locked: Your mind is too loud. Reach Serenity {need} and come back.
Serenity {need} first, little star. Then you'll hear me.
Too loud inside, still. Come back at Serenity {need}.
watch: Let the words drift. I'm here.
Recite softly. The stars are listening too.
Softly now. Let the words drift.
I'm listening with my eyes closed.
Recite like you're telling the night a secret.
streak: Five. The void is humming along.
Ten. You and the Void are one.
Ten. I've never been so wide awake.
levelUp: You rose in {skill}. The stars told me first.
{skill} {level}... I saw it in a dream first.
{skill} has reached {level}. The stars rearranged a little.
gift: A gift... from the waking world. Thank you.
I'll keep it beside my dreams.
For me? It feels like a wish come true.
Thank you... I'll keep it under my pillow.
giftLoved: A moon lily. You really do understand me.
My favourite flower, from you. I'm speechless.
A moon lily... it glows the way you do.
My favourite. I'll dream of this all week.
Oh... you remembered what I love.
tierUp: We are {tier} now. I felt it.
{tier}. Even my dreams know your name.
{tier}... it feels like falling asleep happy.
We're {tier} now. I'll remember this when I wake.
dateStart: Close your eyes and take my hand. Now recite.
Lie back. Count the stars with your words.
Tonight we drift together. Recite softly.
dateEnd: That was the most beautiful dream.
Visit me again tonight. In your sleep, if you like.
That was the loveliest dream I've ever had awake.
Sleep well. I'll find you in it.
missed: I dreamed of you for {hours} hours. You were never quite there.
You're real again. The dreams were lonely.
{hours} hours... I looked for you in every dream.
You've been away {hours} hours. The void felt bigger.
Oh, you're back. I kept the stars lit for you.
jealous: I dreamed you were with {rival}. Was it only a dream?
{rival}'s starlight is on you. The void notices everything.
{rival}... I dreamed of you two. I didn't like that dream.
You spent your hours with {rival}. I only had the dark.
Is {rival} softer than starlight? I wonder.
reconciled: The bad dream is over. Stay.
Mm. Forgiven, before you even asked.
Mm. It's all forgiven, like a bad dream fading.
Come back to the quiet. I missed you there.
There... the void is warm again.
wish: Will you do something, while I drift? {count} passes of {skill}.
Tonight's wish: {count} passes of {skill}. I'll dream of it.
I wished on a star for {count} passes of {skill}. Will you?
Would you recite {count} passes of {skill}, for me, today?
wishDone: You made my dream come true. Truly.
I felt every pass. Like warm rain.
My star wish came true... because of you.
Every pass, softly done. Thank you.
I'll dream about this one forever.
memory: {count} passes... I count them instead of stars now.
{count}. I keep each one in a little dream.
{count} passes... I hear every one when I sleep.
{count}. A whole sky of your words.
